verified: ACEA's October registration release reports battery-electric cars at 23.4% of EU new-car registrations in January–October 2026, up from 16.4% a year earlier, with petrol and diesel combined at 27.7%, down from 36.5%; it also reports 279,799 battery-electric registrations in October alone, up 61.4% year on year.
unconfirmed: That EVs outsold petrol and diesel cars combined in October by nearly 70,000 units, and that the prior-year gap was 127,000, rests on InsideEVs' report; the supplied ACEA figures give year-to-date shares and October BEV volume but no October petrol-plus-diesel total, and the year-to-date shares (BEV 23.4% vs petrol and diesel 27.7%) do not by themselves establish the October overtake. The term “EVs” is also undefined—battery-electric only or including plug-in hybrids.

verified: 欧洲汽车制造商协会（ACEA）11 月 24 日发布的数据显示，2026 年 10 月欧盟纯电动车注册量为 279,799 辆，同比增长 61.4%；1—10 月纯电动车占欧盟新车注册量的 23.4%，高于去年同期的 16.4%，同期汽油车与柴油车合计份额从 36.5% 降至 27.7%（来源：ACEA）。
unconfirmed: InsideEVs 称 10 月单月欧盟电动车销量比汽油车与柴油车合计多出近 7 万辆，而一年前是落后 12.7 万辆；该报道未给出月度分类销量明细，也未说明“电动车”是否只含纯电、是否计入插电混动。ACEA 的年内累计数据仍显示汽油车加柴油车的合计份额（27.7%）高于纯电动车（23.4%），与上述月度反超说法并不直接对应，两套口径的差异报道未作解释。

titles.en: EU EV Sales Beat Gas and Diesel Combined in October, InsideEVs Reports
